items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Well, we were a great success with the Katherine Dunham Show

ctx.x: No - no -- well, she did two Dixie-Land songs but she came out and did a fantastic dance -- now we were doing that show and doubling at Nick's. Now,

just before we got into there - because, you know, I was playing Sunday afternoons at Jimmy Ryan's and doing all those things and it was at this time that Milt [Gabler] that he wanted me to record--- and, of course, you know the Commodore records that I've made and I even made one with Brad when we -- what was left of the Original Dixie-Land Jazz Band--- and we did the jazz band things and Brad played the clarinet. It always amazed me to no end.
